candidates.name: Kettlebell Row (Single)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Row (Single)
Beginner
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Row
Novice
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same hand as the leg shifted backwards.
2
Bend forwards at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knee, keeping your back straight.
3
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Pullover
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Pullover
Advanced
1
Rest your upper back on the bench and place soles of your feet firmly on the floor keeping torso and thighs suspended and parallel to the floor.
2
Hold the kettlebell with both hands above your chest, keeping your arms straight.
3
Keeping your arms straight, move the kettlebell in the direction of your head until your arms are parallel to the floor.
4
Return to starting to position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Shoulder Extension
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Shoulder Extension
Intermediate
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart bending forward at the hips as far as comfortable. Place off-hand on the same side thigh for stability.
2
Hold the kettlebell in one hand, straight armed and pointing towards the floor.
3
Keeping your arm straight, swing the kettlebell behind you as far as comfortable.
4
Return to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Pendlay Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Pendlay Row
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width, hinge forward until torso is nearly parallel to floor.
2
Pick kettlebell from ground with straight arm, keeping back flat and core braced.
3
Pull elbow straight up to ribs, then lower kettlebell fully back to floor each rep.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Pullover
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Pullover
Beginner
1
Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with slight elbow bend.
2
Lower kettlebell in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
3
Pull kettlebell back over chest using lats and triceps, keeping control.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Shoulder Extension
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Shoulder Extension
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell at your sides with straight arms and palms neutral.
2
Move arm backward until you feel lats and rear delts engage.
3
Lower slowly to starting position under full control.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row On Bench
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Row On Bench
Novice
1
Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in one hand.
2
Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground.
3
From this starting position, row the kettlebell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so.
4
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Row
Beginner
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold a kettlebell in each hand.
2
Hinge at hips, keep back straight, and pull both kettlebells to hips.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Gorilla Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Gorilla Row
Intermediate
1
Stand with kettlebell between legs.
2
Hinge at hips, grab kettlebell, pull to chest and rotate at the torso

candidates.name: Kettlebell Alternating Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Alternating Row
Beginner
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell in one hand.
2
Bend at hips, row kettlebell to chest.
3
Alternate hands for each row.
